content.text: God sent me … to save your lives, Gen. 45:7. God meant … to save much people, Gen. 50:20. midwives … saved the men children, Ex. 1:17. Lord saved Israel that day, Ex. 14:30. Lord … fight for you against your enemies, to save you, Deut. 20:4. By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, Judg. 7:7. Lord saveth not with sword and spear, 1 Sam. 17:47. Save us, O God of our salvation, 1 Chr. 16:35 (Ps. 106:47). Lord saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, 2 Chr. 32:22. Lord … saveth such as be of a contrite spirit, Ps. 34:18. neither did their own arm save them, Ps. 44:3. God will save Zion, Ps. 69:35. wait on the Lord, and he shall save thee, Prov. 20:22. Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved, Prov. 28:18. Lord … will save us, Isa. 33:22. Look unto me, and be ye saved, Isa. 45:22. Lord’s hand is not shortened, that it cannot save, Isa. 59:1. angel of his presence saved them, Isa. 63:9. harvest is past … and we are not saved, Jer. 8:20. I am with thee to save thee, Jer. 15:20. Judah shall be saved, Jer. 23:6 (33:16). I will save thee from afar, Jer. 30:10 (46:27). Lord, save thy people, Jer. 31:7. I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, Ezek. 37:23. I will save her that halteth, Zeph. 3:19. I will save my people from the east country, Zech. 8:7. God shall save them in that day, Zech. 9:16.

he shall save his people from their sins, Matt. 1:21. Lord, save us: we perish, Matt. 8:25. he that endureth to the end shall be saved, Matt. 10:22 (24:13; Mark 13:13). beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me, Matt. 14:30. whosoever will save his life shall lose it, Matt. 16:25 (Mark 8:35; Luke 9:24). come to save that which was lost, Matt. 18:11 (Luke 19:10). Who then can be saved, Matt. 19:25 (Mark 10:26; Luke 18:26). except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved, Matt. 24:22 (Mark 13:20). Thou that destroyest the temple … save thyself, Matt. 27:40 (Mark 15:30). He saved others; himself he cannot save, Matt. 27:42 (Mark 15:31; Luke 23:35). Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath … to save life, Mark 3:4 (Luke 6:9). He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved, Mark 16:16 (Morm. 9:23; Ether 4:18; D&C 68:9; 112:29). Thy faith hath saved thee, Luke 7:50 (18:42). Son of man is not come to destroy men’s lives, but to save, Luke 9:56. Lord, are there few that be saved, Luke 13:23. that the world through him might be saved, John 3:17. if any man enter in, he shall be saved, John 10:9. Father, save me from this hour, John 12:27. I came not to judge the world, but to save, John 12:47. call on the name of the Lord shall be saved, Acts 2:21 (Rom. 10:13). Save yourselves from this untoward generation, Acts 2:40 (D&C 36:6). added to the church daily such as should be saved, Acts 2:47. none other name … whereby we must be saved, Acts 4:12 (2 Ne. 25:20; D&C 18:23). Except ye be circumcised … ye cannot be saved, Acts 15:1. Believe on the Lord … thou shalt be saved, Acts 16:31 (Rom. 10:9; Alma 12:15; Moses 5:15). we shall be saved by his life, Rom. 5:10. Israel … a remnant shall be saved, Rom. 9:27. prayer … for Israel is, that they might be saved, Rom. 10:1. Israel shall be saved: as it is written, Rom. 11:26. preaching of the cross … unto us which are saved it is the power of God, 1 Cor. 1:18. by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe, 1 Cor. 1:21. spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord, 1 Cor. 5:5. shalt save thy husband? or … shalt save thy wife, 1 Cor. 7:16. I please all men … that they may be saved, 1 Cor. 10:33. By which also ye are saved, 1 Cor. 15:2. by grace are ye saved through faith, Eph. 2:8. Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, 1 Thes. 2:16. love of the truth, that they might be saved, 2 Thes. 2:10. Jesus came into the world to save sinners, 1 Tim. 1:15. Who will have all men to be saved, 1 Tim. 2:4. shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee, 1 Tim. 4:16. Who hath saved us, and called us, 2 Tim. 1:9. prayers … unto him that was able to save him from death, Heb. 5:7. receive … word, which is able to save, James 1:21. have not works? can faith save him, James 2:14. one lawgiver, who is able to save, James 4:12. prayer of faith shall save the sick, James 5:15. converteth … shall save a soul from death, James 5:20. eight souls were saved by water, 1 Pet. 3:20. if the righteous scarcely be saved, 1 Pet. 4:18. spared not the old world, but saved Noah, 2 Pet. 2:5. Lord, having saved the people out … of Egypt, Jude 1:5. nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light, Rev. 21:24.

persuade men to … be saved, 1 Ne. 6:4. all men must come unto him, or they cannot be saved, 1 Ne. 13:40. they that believe in him shall be saved, 2 Ne. 2:9. may save all men if they will hearken, 2 Ne. 9:21. through the grace of God that ye are saved, 2 Ne. 10:24. by grace that we are saved, after all we can do, 2 Ne. 25:23. at last we shall be saved, 2 Ne. 28:8. He that endureth to the end, the same shall be saved, 2 Ne. 31:15 (Alma 32:13). relying wholly upon … him who is mighty to save, 2 Ne. 31:19. neither are there any conditions whereby man can be saved except the conditions which I have told you, Mosiah 4:8. that I may be an instrument in thy hands to save and preserve this people, Alma 2:30. no man be saved except his garments are washed white, Alma 5:21. God … who is mighty to save, Alma 7:14 (34:18; D&C 133:47). saith that the Son of God shall come, but he shall not save, Alma 11:35. because I said he shall not save his people in their sins, Alma 11:36. let us … save them from the flames, Alma 14:10. suffered all manner of afflictions … that perhaps we might be the means of saving some soul, Alma 26:30. as though they were angels sent from God to save them, Alma 27:4. nothing can save this people save it be repentance, Hel. 13:6. I have come … to save the world from sin, 3 Ne. 9:21. whoso believeth in me, and is baptized, the same shall be saved, 3 Ne. 11:33. fortify the city of Shem … that perhaps we might save them, Morm. 2:21. saved by faith in his name, Moro. 7:26. if little children could not be saved without baptism, Moro. 8:13.

baptized … endure in faith to the end, should be saved, D&C 20:25. worship the Father in his name … or they cannot be saved, D&C 20:29. Israel shall be saved in mine own due time, D&C 35:25. Israel shall be saved, and I will lead them, D&C 38:33. save all the money that ye can, D&C 48:4. he only is saved who endureth unto the end, D&C 53:7. through him all might be saved, D&C 76:42. angels sent forth from God … to save life, D&C 77:8. impossible for a man to be saved in ignorance, D&C 131:6. remain separately and singly, without exaltation, in their saved condition, D&C 132:17. enter ye into my law and ye shall be saved, D&C 132:32. all children who die … are saved in the celestial kingdom, D&C 137:10. by obedience to the principles of the gospel, mankind might be saved, D&C 138:4 (A of F 1:3).
all the sons of Noah should be saved with a temporal salvation, Moses 7:42. Egyptians … will kill you, but they will save her, Abr. 2:23.
